capabilities: Run and steer Codex agent conversations in sidebar panels
Reference notes, selections, and daily notes in prompts with @active, @selection, and @today
Rewrite selected text with a diff preview before applying changes
Review file changes and tool/subagent activity while the agent works
Search, resume, rename, and archive past conversations, optionally as Markdown notes
extras: Depends on the experimental codex app-server API; requires Obsidian desktop (min 1.14.4) with a local vault and CLI tested at version 0.169.0; the panel reuses the user's existing Codex skills, MCP servers, and plugins.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to work with an AI coding/agent assistant inside the vault, let alone one that understands wikilinks, daily notes, and open files.

relations.evidence: Codex Panel brings Codex into Obsidian, so you can work with it alongside your notes

summary: Sidebar panel that runs the Codex CLI agent alongside your notes, with note-aware prompts, diff previews, and conversation management.
